problem_statement: Developers want to use Claude Code's Anthropic Messages API against an Azure-hosted GPT-5.4 model without managing a local model adapter.
hypothesis: A publicly reachable LiteLLM proxy on Azure Container Apps can translate Claude Code requests to a Foundry GPT-5.4 deployment and return a single generated proxy URL, model name, and API key that Claude Code can use directly.
customer_scenario: Teams standardizing on Claude Code workflows while routing requests through Azure AI Foundry models and Azure-controlled credentials.
data_requirements: No production data. The test uses a synthetic prompt and does not persist request content.
security_notes: Prototype only. The public proxy is protected by a generated LiteLLM master key, but it is internet-facing and uses a provider API key in a Container App secret. Do not commit env/.env. Rotate both keys and add stronger identity, rate limiting, and network controls before production use.
